messages:
maria: quick heads-up — ran a few microflux sampling experiments on continuous batching this morning. noticing ~20-30% token/sec dips correlated with KV-cache miss storms. want to tune formation heuristics and add a couple dashboard panels. :eyes:
ashok: can you paste the rough numbers/queries?
maria: sure. gist: batch_utilization drops from ~0.78 -> 0.45 when kv miss rate spikes > 12%. queue depth spikes first, then tokens/sec drops. i dumped a few traces and a flamegraph.
maria: example PromQL i used:```
avg_over_time(batch_utilization_ratio[5m])
avg_over_time(continuous_batch_queue_depth[5m])
sum(rate(tokens_generated_total[1m])) by (deployment)
avg_over_time(kv_cache_hitrate[1m])
```
lee: nice. two quick ideas — 1) make token_budget adaptive to seq_len p50/p90 histogram instead of fixed 512. 2) add a small age cap so old requests don't bloat headroom.
ashok: +1. what's the current heuristic in prod config?
maria: current prod-ish snippet:```yaml
queue_policy: age_and_size
max_wait_ms: 40
token_budget_per_batch: 512
max_batch_tokens: 4096
microbatch_jitter_ms: 5
sample_trace_rate: 0.01
```
jq: FYI we saw a perf regression after kernel selector change (commit abc123). kernel_exec_latency_ms_p95 for the new kernel jumped ~18ms on long sequences — that amplifies the token/sec hit when batches are malformed.
maria: that matches my flamegraphs — kernel handoff cost + repeated kv misses cascades. i think telemetry should show kernel_choice and kernel_latency per-batch to help correlate.
lee: agree — add a derived metric: `kernel_penalty = kernel_exec_p95 * (1 - kv_cache_hitrate)` so dashboards can highlight bad combos.
ashok: we should also surface sampling of short vs long sequences. add panel: seq_len_cohort_token_rate (p10/p50/p90). want to avoid cardinality explosion though.
lee: keep cohorts coarse (<=64, 65-256, 257-1024, >1024). that keeps metrics small.
maria: proposed dashboard panels (quick):
- Batch overview: batch_utilization_ratio, continuous_batch_queue_depth, avg_batch_size_tokens, tokens_per_second (timeseries + heatmap)
- KV & kernel correlation: kv_cache_hitrate, kernel_choice (stacked), kernel_exec_latency_ms_p95, kernel_penalty (calculated)
- Formation health: sample of microbatch age distribution, token_budget_utilization, rejected_by_capacity_count
ashok: i'll add queries for the first two panels, can pair with you tomorrow.
maria: also want an alert: if tokens_per_second drops >30% vs rolling 30m and kv_cache_hitrate < 0.5 then page on-call. encourage starting with a P4.
jq: recommend we instrument an ephemeral canary that flips token_budget to adaptive on one shard to validate before wider rollout. deploy-bot: canary deployed to shard microflux-canary-7 at 2987654700 :rocket:
maria: perfect. i'll schedule a 30m pairing to wire the dashboard + add the kernel metrics. when we're done we can run a 2h load with synthetic kv-miss bursts and collect traces.
lee: one more ops note — keep sampling_rate for full traces low (0.5-1%) and upsample traces that hit kernel_penalty > threshold. that keeps ingest cost reasonable.
maria: agreed. thanks all :chart_with_upwards_trend: we'll reconvene after the canary run.
